nonblockingLimits: Approval covers the complete proposed work and acceptance criteria, not unbuilt artwork, publication or a promised score.
My inspected application evidence remains local and static. Live placement, broader rendering conditions and audience association are not established.
Quiet typography and a head-only avatar are not demonstrated identity failures. Species identification, owner association and expert visual distinctiveness remain separate questions.
My existing 8/10 static-application craft judgment remains scoped and unchanged; evidence, confidence, deductions and improvement criteria remain in independent/identity-a.json.
rationale: I read the entire proposal and score policy and verified the exact requested hash. P3 preserves the complete silhouette, shared geometry, readable wordmark and documented universal day avatar while testing optional night paint separately. Actual-size comparisons and supported-ground records directly address the reviewed optical limitation.

Reversible artistic exploration is appropriate even when the baseline works. Adoption still needs a named observed benefit and acceptable tradeoffs; retaining the control remains valid. Paint changes must be acknowledged as contour changes rather than concealed behind numeric geometry parity.

P1 and P2 connect personality and rhythm to a truthful subject without enlarging anatomy. P4 addresses reading and control behavior using direct observations. P5 requires renderer proof, preserves provenance and updates affected applications. P6 appropriately separates fresh individual craft judgments, owner preference and human evidence; target scores cannot dictate conclusions.
These are sound cross-disciplinary priorities and review conditions. My agreement does not independently verify every discipline’s current defect or substitute for their implementation review.
